def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0) & (2500 <= df['body_mass_g']) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    avg_body_mass = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_body_mass
